ScopeV1.semantic_rules: All values are authenticated by the receiving authority; repository ID is the stable GitHub numeric ID, never owner/name. Epochs must match current authority.

GitOidV1.semantic_rules: Exactly 20 bytes for SHA1 or 32 for SHA256. SHA256 cells disabled until separately qualified; never reinterpret old OIDs.

MergeSubjectV2.semantic_rules: Observed through protected provider read-back; all OIDs use one algorithm. expires_at > observed_at. HEAD_ONLY_NONMERGE cannot authorize integrated merge.

WorkflowSpecCoreV2.semantic_rules: No attempt digest here: immutable workflow is hashed before attempt allocation; no cyclic binding.

AttemptBindingV2.semantic_rules: Lease acceptance additionally checks actual protected DB row under lock at database clock time. Signed snapshot never extends a lease. workflow has no attempt digest.

AnalysisUnitV1.semantic_rules: Referenced descriptors are canonical ManifestDescriptorV1 records pinned before execution; complete file/symbol sets cannot be supplied solely by hostile repository configuration.

ManifestDescriptorV1.semantic_rules: Entries use policy-owned keys; unknown key rejects for the pinned analyzer configuration schema digest in PolicyVersionV1. These records are retained with the manifest.

DescriptorEntryV1.semantic_rules: Value is opaque exact configuration bytes interpreted only under a policy-approved analyzer configuration schema, not by the signer. Security meaning requires the policy-approved schema digest; no free-form override can disable mandatory units.

ExpectedAnalysisManifestV1.semantic_rules: Nonempty required_units with unique unit_id; commit before any unit execution. PASS requires exactly one accepted successful completion for every unit, with matching digests and policy coverage; finding_count=0 still requires a receipt.

AnalysisCompletionReceiptV1.semantic_rules: Producer signature verifies authenticated workload only; protected verifier validates manifest matching, coverage and live lease before acceptance. Zero findings is not proof of execution absent this receipt.

OracleTrustClassV1.semantic_rules: Origin asserted by runner is untrusted. Policy/evidence authority validates independently trusted source and applicability. MAINTAINER_APPROVED requires both options; UNTRUSTED_AGENT_EXPECTATION never blocks regardless of reproduction.

EvidenceReceiptV2.semantic_rules: Receipt signature establishes provenance; accepted evidence requires evidence authority and current trust. E3 requires valid oracle in addition to base-pass/candidate-fail.

VerificationReceiptV2.semantic_rules: C3 requires independently registered administrative domain from producer and other required runs, not a self-declared string. Expired attempt cannot submit authoritative results.

VerificationSetV2.semantic_rules: Immutable set, recomputed digest; every receipt signature, applicability, class, epoch and component revocation verified by Gate Authority.

EvaluationIdentityV2.semantic_rules: Identity is not a mutable verdict or current pointer; supersession creates new identity and projection generation.

GateProofV2.semantic_rules: Protected gate signer independently validates all trusted inputs against authority/write matrix, mandatory coverage, oracle qualification and current subject. PASS is disallowed for missing/untrusted work; signature is not sufficient without currentness checks.

PolicyVersionV1.semantic_rules: Policy Authority writes only through policy authorization ceremony. Immutable content, activation pointer protected. Normal staged update vs emergency immediate revocation follows 54.

TrustBundleV1.semantic_rules: Trust Authority verifies administrative domain registration outside ordinary API. Revocation checked online, never only via cached bundle expiry.

TrustMemberV1.semantic_rules: Role is a closed deployment registration from authority matrix; unrecognized role cannot authorize any operation.

RevocationRecordV1.semantic_rules: Immutable and monotonic. Restore may not lower effective generation; journal EPOCH_FENCE records protect recovery.

CurrentCandidateV1.semantic_rules: Only protected provider-read authority writes. Webhooks trigger read-back; raw webhook data cannot advance truth.

ChangedObjectV1.semantic_rules: DELETE has absent blob fields and zero length; others require both. Refuse absolute/dot-dot/NUL/duplicate paths; symlink is materialized as link bytes not traversed. Gitlinks/submodules need separate enabled cell; no implicit mode conversion.

VerifiedPublicationPlanV2.semantic_rules: destination_ref must equal refs/heads/mastercoder/fix/ + lower UUID publication_id. Effects are finite typed requests with dependencies, no update/delete/merge. All retained request metadata and exact bytes are digest-bound; verifier independently derives candidate tree. Custody is referenced by ID to avoid a digest cycle with PatchCustodyV1 plan_digest.

ArtifactCustodyEntryV1.semantic_rules: Opaque tenant scoped object handle, never fetch arbitrary caller URL. Blob bytes fetched over authenticated custodian endpoint and digest/size validated.

PatchCustodyV1.semantic_rules: Revisioned immutable snapshots. Pin lifetime covers display through terminal reconciliation; expiry/loss invalidates approval and blocks unstarted calls. Reacquisition cannot silently reconstruct alternative bytes; fresh verification/approval required. Legal hold never grants publication authority.

ApprovalCredentialBindingV1.semantic_rules: Scope repository_id=0 only for tenant enrollment; authorization_scope explicitly names allowed repositories and is evaluated against publication scope. ES256 COSE key must be valid canonical WebAuthn key; only -7/P-256 accepted initially. Ordinary OIDC recovery cannot mint/change this binding.

TrustedDisplayReceiptV1.semantic_rules: Produced by Approval Authority controlled origin using independently fetched plan/bytes; no ordinary-app diff or caller-provided digest accepted as display truth. Browser/OS compromise is residual threat.

ApprovalChallengeV2.semantic_rules: WebAuthn challenge = SHA256(domain-separated canonical challenge record), served only directly by approval origin. Nonce consumed once in same transaction as assertion creation; no challenge reuse.

HumanApprovalAssertionV2.semantic_rules: Detached Approval Authority signature after fresh direct UV. Gateway resolves current binding/generation, revocation, scope, custody and exact plan before each effect STARTED; assertion expiry cannot authorize a whole future sequence.

WebAuthnCeremonyV1.semantic_rules: Exact received bytes, do not JSON reserialize before checking WebAuthn signature. Verify type webauthn.get, base64url challenge, exact origin/RP hash, UP/UV, credential key, flags/extension policy, session and unused challenge. ES256 DER signature follows WebAuthn, distinct from Ed25519 authority envelope.

PublicationOperationV1.semantic_rules: Parent is orchestration only and NEVER grants STARTED authority to children; every child independently authorized.

GitPublicationCapabilityV2.semantic_rules: One effect, one credential-free caller capability. Gateway independently derives allowed exact path/body and rejects all generic provider URLs, HTTP methods, updates, deletes, bypass and merges. Token itself has broader residual Contents write authority.

EffectIntentV2.semantic_rules: Immutable per provider call; state remains initial PENDING in this hashed intent. Runtime state is EffectStateV1. No transparent HTTP retry/redirect; new call requires own intent and provider-specific safe-retry proof. Provider = OTHER only for model/dependency allowed profile, never Git effects.

EffectStateV1.semantic_rules: Append-only revisions, live pointer protected by CAS. STARTED has started_at; CONFIRMED requires provider-result identity proof. FAILED_TERMINAL requires proven non-execution or terminal provider error; timeout/404 alone is UNKNOWN. No ABSENT_CONFIRMED.

ExternalEffectJournalV1.semantic_rules: Append-only journal in independent restore domain, synchronous verified witness receipt before send; full reconstructable intent/request retained by custody. Missing confirmation means DO NOT SEND. Detached signatures by journal/witness identities. No restore of ordinary DB may lower witness high-watermark or re-arm old intent.

JournalWitnessReceiptV1.semantic_rules: Witness signs only after durable write of complete entry and retrievable referenced intent/request; configured recovery quorum policy must survive admitted failure model.

CheckProjectionV2.semantic_rules: Only dedicated check App; generation serialization and read-back cover delayed writes. SUCCESS needs current PASS proof. Internal invalidation cannot atomically retract provider result; emergency freeze must be externally confirmed or merging considered unsafe. evaluation_id is allocated early; evaluation_identity_digest is absent only before final manifest/verification inputs exist. SUCCESS requires present exact finalized identity matching gate proof. Pre-verdict writes have no fabricated zero identity.

ModelIntentV2.semantic_rules: One use, budget consumed atomically under live lease before each call; actual spend settles even after lease loss. Currency is pinned in root resource envelope.

ModelMessageV1.semantic_rules: Exact bounded content resides in ephemeral tenant custody, never audit. TOOL requires correlated previous unique tool_call_id.

ModelToolV1.semantic_rules: Approved exact tool schema digest; a tool cannot mint authority beyond root envelope.

ModelTurnV2.semantic_rules: Ordered messages; tool IDs unique. No credentials, arbitrary headers or destination URL. Provider adapter maps only approved profile and rejects unsupported parameter/tool semantics.

ResourceEnvelopeV2.semantic_rules: Every descendant charges one protected root ledger; reservations serializable, no child budget creation. Native hidden-agent mode limited by measured outer envelope, no claimed internal accounting.

EligibilityProofV2.semantic_rules: Stable PR opener and current role/membership read-back required; commit author strings and stale cached membership do not grant eligibility.

CheckoutGrantV2.semantic_rules: Finite read-only grant, exact OIDs; no reusable credential enters parser or guest. Replacement only after safe termination/reconciliation.

DependencyPackageV1.semantic_rules: Exact hash lock, no floating branch/version; broker authenticates registry and verifies bytes. Git requires exact commit and fetched content hash; package metadata cannot add endpoints.

DependencyAcquisitionGrantV1.semantic_rules: One-use bounded acquisition; no lifecycle scripts inside credential broker. Installation scripts run credential-free in sandbox. Private cache tenant scoped; redirects/DNS/private-address changes revalidated against approved endpoints.

ManualResolutionV1.semantic_rules: Fresh UV challenge binds D(ManualResolutionActionV1,action) and challenge_nonce via ResolutionChallengeV1, never the final ManualResolutionV1 containing ceremony digest. One-use challenge consumed under case/current scope locks. No action digest cycle. Ceremony independently authorizes resolver scope; ordinary account recovery cannot grant it.

FindingCandidateV2.semantic_rules: Untrusted claim until evidence authority acceptance. No provider/gate privilege.

PatchCandidateV2.semantic_rules: Advisory; candidate tree and publication plan are independently verified.

AttemptEventV2.semantic_rules: Payload is a registered contract digest only. At least once, sequence scoped to producer session; replay cannot revive authority; occurred_at does not determine leases.

ProducerEventV2.semantic_rules: Non-attempt authoritative events require specific authorized producer role; ordinary API cannot publish trust/epoch/policy changes merely by using this envelope.

ProviderEventV2.semantic_rules: Webhook signature authenticates delivery; protected fresh readback establishes subject. Dedupe stable installation/delivery identity.

AuditEnvelopeV1.semantic_rules: Metadata only, no raw source, secrets, free-form reason text, prompt, patch or request/response bodies. Subject digest points to protected authorized record. Immutable hash chain plus external seals; seal delay does not confer authority.

SignedEnvelopeV1.semantic_rules: Ed25519 detached signature; exact signature input defined in ENCODING.md. Signer key is authorized for payload type and authenticated scope/current epoch, not merely cryptographically valid.

CreateBlobRequestV1.semantic_rules: POST /repos/{resolved_owner}/{resolved_repo}/git/blobs; encoding=base64 and content exact pinned bytes; returned sha must equal expected OID.

TreeEntryV1.semantic_rules: Mode closed to 100644/100755/120000. Missing oid means deletion; Gitlink unsupported unless new qualified schema revision. Request translator maps missing option to provider JSON null only, never canonical null.

CreateTreeRequestV1.semantic_rules: POST /git/trees; fixed base_tree plus exact entries; reject duplicate paths and returned-tree mismatch.

CommitIdentityV1.semantic_rules: Exact UTF-8 Git identity bytes, no CR/LF/NUL/angle-bracket injection; timezone -1439..1439. Commit headers rendered deterministically from these fields; no provider-supplied current time.

CreateCommitRequestV1.semantic_rules: POST /git/commits with exactly one verified parent; exact UTF8 message, identities and dates; no signature field unless new approved schema. Verify returned object, tree and expected SHA.

CreateRefRequestV1.semantic_rules: POST /git/refs; namespace exact publication UUID; ref must be absent and create-only. Existing ref conflict is reconciliation, never PATCH.

CreateFixPrRequestV1.semantic_rules: POST /pulls only; exact refs and pinned title/body with stable publication marker. Body/title UTF8 and bounded; no auto-merge settings, existing PR edits, or arbitrary issue endpoints.

CheckWriteRequestV1.semantic_rules: Dedicated Review Broker only. POST check-runs if ID absent, PATCH exact check-run if present. Name=Mastercoder Review; external_id binds projection UUID and generation. SUCCESS requires present current PASS GateProofV2. IN_PROGRESS or withdrawal FAILURE may omit proof and must bind current authorized CheckProjectionV2. Missing proof never permits SUCCESS; output is exact metadata-only CheckOutputV1.

EffectPlanEntryV1.semantic_rules: request_type restricted to five Create* Git publication request schemas. Acyclic ordered dependencies; no effect ID needed before runtime intents. Each request scope/publication ID equals parent plan.

PublicationEffectsV1.semantic_rules: Finite topological sequence of blob/tree/commit/ref/PR effects. Request schemas are closed; root plan effects_digest hashes this record. Requests cannot include plan digest, avoiding recursive hash dependency.

AuthorityScopeV1.semantic_rules: Closed permission vocabulary: APPROVE_PUBLICATION, REGISTER_APPROVER, REVOKE_APPROVER, RECOVER_APPROVER, RESOLVE_FINDING, RECONCILE_EFFECT, ACTIVATE_POLICY, ROTATE_TRUST. Unknown permission rejects; empty repository list grants none, never wildcard.

ProviderResultV1.semantic_rules: Exact provider identity and request matching verified read-only; HTTP status alone never proves matching effect. Result readback evidence retained with journal.

DbStartCertificateV1.semantic_rules: Protected effect authority signs only after committed STARTED transition with all current/expiry predicates. A DB timestamp is not proof by itself; journal validates authenticated certificate and current epoch fence.

JournalEpochFenceV1.semantic_rules: Same ordered witnessed chain as ExternalEffectJournalV1, distinguished by exact type. New epoch is random UUID, compared only by equality. Both witness acknowledgments required; previous epoch never becomes current again. No invented effect ID.

ManualResolutionActionV1.semantic_rules: Pre-ceremony immutable proposed decision. Trusted resolution origin displays this exact action and evidence. No PASS choice. Policy/oracle changes create fresh evaluation, and terminal nonexecution requires exact provider proof.

ResolutionChallengeV1.semantic_rules: Five-minute challenge from trusted resolution origin; exact action, active independently scoped resolver credential and UV required. Ceremony challenge bytes D(ResolutionChallengeV1,challenge), verified analogous to approval; resolution authority signs final envelope only after action commit.

ApprovalEnrollmentActionV1.semantic_rules: Final post-registration action binds current-epoch intent and create proof/new key, except REVOKE/SUSPEND require absent ceremony and empty new key/ID. Required owner/administrator consents or offline signatures bind this exact action under52. CHANGE_BINDING re-registers a fresh key, with owner consent plus required admin scope authorization. No OIDC recovery or stale-epoch replay authorizes.

ApprovalEnrollmentChallengeV1.semantic_rules: WebAuthn registration challenge bytes D(ApprovalEnrollmentChallengeV1,challenge). Intent precedes credential generation. A successful create ceremony yields new key, after which final action and required authority signatures are collected; neither provisional intent nor ceremony alone grants approval scope.

WebAuthnRegistrationCeremonyV1.semantic_rules: Exact WebAuthn create ceremony bytes. Verify client type webauthn.create, exact origin/challenge/session/RP, UV/UP, attested credential ID/public key, valid ES256 P-256 point, exclusion list and registration policy. Attestation policy initially none allowed only where declared; attestation is not approval-role authorization. Digest is registration_ceremony_digest on binding.

ApprovalRecoveryPolicyV1.semantic_rules: DUAL_ADMIN sets minimum_authorities>=2 for INITIAL_BOOTSTRAP, RECOVER and scope expansion; ordinary nonexpanding ADD/REPLACE use owner consent, INITIAL_REGISTRATION uses one currently registered administrator. INDIVIDUAL_OFFLINE substitutes pre-established offline signature and fresh provider-owner proof for bootstrap/recovery only; owner operations still require active owner UV. Exact operation quorum is52. Policy cannot lower minima; new independent bootstrap fences all old approval authority.

ApprovalEnrollmentAuthorizationV1.semantic_rules: Enroller verifies current epoch, action->intent->create challenge->registration chain where required; consent_receipt_digests resolve signed ApprovalLifecycleConsentV1, authority_signature_envelope_digests contain only independently registered offline bootstrap/recovery signatures over exact action. Enforce operation-specific52 quorum; no publication assertion substituted. Audit and new binding commit with nonce consumption and old-binding revocation atomically.

ModelContentBlockV1.semantic_rules: TEXT: content_digest present, call/tool/arguments/is_error absent. TOOL_USE: call+tool+arguments present, content/is_error absent, truncated=false; arguments are exact JSON validated against ModelToolV1 input schema. TOOL_RESULT: call+content+is_error present, tool/arguments absent; error/truncation explicit. Content/prompt bytes remain in bounded ephemeral custody; missing bytes reject the turn.

ModelContentV1.semantic_rules: Ordered complete message content; ModelMessageV1 content_custody_digest locates exact canonical ModelContentV1 bytes and nested content. Broker validates role constraints, unique call IDs and each result against prior unconsumed tool use in same session.

ApprovalEnrollmentIntentV1.semantic_rules: Pre-registration intent has no not-yet-generated credential ID/key. Authority verifies existing privileges/ownership before issuing create challenge. Current epoch, scope and independent bootstrap policy mandatory.

AnalysisPlanV1.semantic_rules: Logical required work sealed before allocation, no attempt/manifest/workflow digest. Manifest after allocation copies exact units and subject/policy from plan; repository config cannot weaken required work.

CapabilityProfileV1.semantic_rules: Approved profile signed by capability/trust authority. Production requires all applicable accepted unexpired prototype evidence. Empty model set permitted FAST only; no C3 without independently registered administrative domains.

CheckOutputV1.semantic_rules: Metadata-only trusted template output. Provider summary generated from fixed code and exact identifiers; no arbitrary markdown, repository source or caller URL. Digest is CheckWriteRequestV1.output_digest. No finalized evaluation identity exists before manifest/verification completion; initial output may omit it. SUCCESS output must include the same identity as its present GateProofV2.

ApprovalLifecycleChallengeV1.semantic_rules: Post-registration action challenge for webauthn.get with fresh UV. D(ApprovalLifecycleChallengeV1,challenge) is authenticator challenge. AA fetches exact action and renders user/scope/new key/replacement target. Purpose and current actor role checked against operation matrix in52; not usable for publication or oracle approval.

ApprovalLifecycleConsentV1.semantic_rules: AA signs only after fresh validated WebAuthnCeremonyV1 using ApprovalLifecycleChallengeV1; digest references include exact action and independently enrolled current actor role. Count distinct actor_id, not keys, for dual quorum. Ordinary API cannot create receipt.

AcquisitionRequestV1.semantic_rules: One exact credential-free acquisition HTTP request. target is exact ASCII origin-form path/query bytes, no host override, fragment, CR/LF/NUL, userinfo or absolute URL. Broker derives origin/method/target/body and selected OID/package solely from qualified grant/adapter. selection_digest is D(GitOidV1) for checkout or D(DependencyPackageV1) for package; request grant and scope must agree. Each metadata/object/package/network call has separate intent; redirects never reuse authority. Secrets injected by dialer are not persisted.

ManualCaseStateV1.semantic_rules: Resolution Authority immutable case-state snapshot; subject_type names one registered exact record. ManualResolutionActionV1.prior_state_digest references this snapshot, case_id/subject/scope must agree, and commit CAS checks exact current revision. No prior-case digest may be substituted for an effect-state payload.
